An original young woman with long, wavy light
blonde hair wears a white crinkle-texture cropped
zip shirt with a pointed collar and heart-shaped
zipper pulls, a small logo patch, and a black choker
with a heart charm. A gray plaid mini skirt sits
under a studded black belt. Her expression is calm.
A casting board of photos behind her and a softbox
